translations.en.sahih: By the sky containing great stars
translations.en.pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
translations.en.yusufali: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
translations.id.indonesian: Demi langit yang mempunyai gugusan bintang,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the promised Day
translations.en.pickthall: And by the Promised Day.
translations.en.yusufali: By the promised Day (of Judgment);
translations.id.indonesian: dan hari yang dijanjikan,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
translations.en.pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
translations.en.yusufali: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan yang menyaksikan dan yang disaksikan.

translations.en.sahih: Cursed were the companions of the trench
translations.en.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
translations.en.yusufali: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
translations.id.indonesian: Binasa dan terlaknatlah orang-orang yang membuat parit,

translations.en.sahih: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
translations.en.pickthall: Of the fuel-fed fire,
translations.en.yusufali: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:
translations.id.indonesian: yang berapi (dinyalakan dengan) kayu bakar,

translations.en.sahih: When they were sitting near it
translations.en.pickthall: When they sat by it,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
translations.id.indonesian: ketika mereka duduk di sekitarnya,

arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
transliteration: Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood

translations.en.sahih: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
translations.en.pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
translations.en.yusufali: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
translations.id.indonesian: sedang mereka menyaksikan apa yang mereka perbuat terhadap orang-orang yang beriman.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
transliteration: Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed

translations.en.sahih: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
translations.en.pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
translations.en.yusufali: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka tidak menyiksa orang-orang mukmin itu melainkan karena orang-orang mukmin itu beriman kepada Allah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Terpuji,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
transliteration: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed

translations.en.sahih: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
translations.en.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
translations.en.yusufali: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
translations.id.indonesian: Yang mempunyai kerajaan langit dan bumi; dan Allah Maha Menyaksikan segala sesuatu.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
transliteration: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
translations.en.yusufali: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang mendatangkan cobaan kepada orang-orang yang mukmin laki-laki dan perempuan kemudian mereka tidak bertaubat, maka bagi mereka azab Jahannam dan bagi mereka azab (neraka) yang membakar.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
translations.en.yusufali: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal-amal yang saleh bagi mereka surga yang mengalir di bawahnya sungai-sungai; itulah keberuntungan yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya azab Tuhanmu benar-benar keras.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Dialah Yang menciptakan (makhluk) dari permulaan dan menghidupkannya (kembali).

translations.en.sahih: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
translations.en.pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
translations.en.yusufali: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
translations.id.indonesian: Dialah Yang Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Pengasih,

translations.en.sahih: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
translations.en.yusufali: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
translations.id.indonesian: yang mempunyai 'Arsy, lagi Maha Mulia,

translations.en.sahih: Effecter of what He intends.
translations.en.pickthall: Doer of what He will.
translations.en.yusufali: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
translations.id.indonesian: Maha Kuasa berbuat apa yang dikehendaki-Nya.

translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
translations.en.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
translations.en.yusufali: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
translations.id.indonesian: Sudahkah datang kepadamu berita kaum-kaum penentang,

translations.en.sahih: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
translations.en.pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?
translations.en.yusufali: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu kaum) Fir'aun dan (kaum) Tsamud?

translations.en.sahih: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
translations.en.yusufali: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir selalu mendustakan,

translations.en.sahih: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
translations.en.pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
translations.en.yusufali: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
translations.id.indonesian: padahal Allah mengepung mereka dari belakang mereka.

translations.en.sahih: But this is an honored Qur'an
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan yang didustakan mereka itu ialah Al Quran yang mulia,

translations.en.sahih: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
translations.en.pickthall: On a guarded tablet.
translations.en.yusufali: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!
translations.id.indonesian: yang (tersimpan) dalam Lauh Mahfuzh.
